CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   D. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   C. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   C. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   D. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Story: Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible Story; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. D — Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Story: Holy Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Bible Story;; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
